This neonate mass is comparable to that observed in related anurans that also produce large numbers of small eggs from a single clutch. The rapid early growth phase that follows eclosion must therefore be fueled almost entirely by exogenous feeding, as the yolk reserves of the lecithotrophic tadpole are entirely consumed prior to metamorphosis.
